shortDescription: Malaysia’s central bank is expected to leave interest rates unchanged on Thursday, according to Bloomberg. Policymakers have little reason to tighten because inflation remains subdued, even as economic growth holds up.

title: Malaysia Central Bank Seen Holding Rates Amid Mild Inflation
